patient_diagnoses_resolved_fields.name: patient_diagnoses_resolved_fields
patient_diagnoses_resolved_fields.value: case when "patient_diagnoses"."status" = 'resolved' then "patient_diagnoses"."resolved_in_visit_id" is not null and "patient_diagnoses"."resolved_at" is not null else "patient_diagnoses"."resolved_in_visit_id" is null and "patient_diagnoses"."resolved_at" is null end

treatment_plans_performed_fields.name: treatment_plans_performed_fields
treatment_plans_performed_fields.value: case when "treatment_plans"."status" = 'performed' then "treatment_plans"."performed_in_visit_id" is not null and "treatment_plans"."performed_at" is not null else "treatment_plans"."performed_in_visit_id" is null and "treatment_plans"."performed_at" is null end

treatment_plans_cancelled_fields.name: treatment_plans_cancelled_fields
treatment_plans_cancelled_fields.value: case when "treatment_plans"."status" = 'cancelled' then "treatment_plans"."cancelled_in_visit_id" is not null and "treatment_plans"."cancelled_at" is not null else "treatment_plans"."cancelled_in_visit_id" is null and "treatment_plans"."cancelled_at" is null end

visit_services_plan_unique.name: visit_services_plan_unique
visit_services_plan_unique.where: "visit_services"."deleted_at" is null and "visit_services"."plan_id" is not null

visits_completed_fields.name: visits_completed_fields
visits_completed_fields.value: "visits"."status"::text not in ('completed', 'amended', 'voided') or ("visits"."completed_at" is not null and "visits"."completed_by" is not null and "visits"."duration_minutes" is not null and "visits"."subtotal" is not null and "visits"."discount_amount" is not null and "visits"."total" is not null)

visits_discarded_fields.name: visits_discarded_fields
visits_discarded_fields.value: "visits"."status" <> 'discarded' or ("visits"."discarded_at" is not null and "visits"."discarded_by" is not null)

visits_voided_fields.name: visits_voided_fields
visits_voided_fields.value: ("visits"."status"::text = 'voided') = ("visits"."voided_at" is not null and "visits"."voided_by" is not null and "visits"."void_reason" is not null)

visits_money_consistent.name: visits_money_consistent
visits_money_consistent.value: "visits"."total" is null or ("visits"."subtotal" >= 0 and "visits"."discount_amount" >= 0 and "visits"."discount_amount" <= "visits"."subtotal" and "visits"."total" = "visits"."subtotal" - "visits"."discount_amount")

contacts_linked_patient_unique.name: contacts_linked_patient_unique
contacts_linked_patient_unique.where: "contacts"."linked_patient_id" is not null and "contacts"."deleted_at" is null

contacts_linked_or_named.name: contacts_linked_or_named
contacts_linked_or_named.value: "contacts"."linked_patient_id" is not null or "contacts"."full_name" is not null

patients_merged_requires_archived.name: patients_merged_requires_archived
patients_merged_requires_archived.value: "patients"."merged_into_id" is null or "patients"."deleted_at" is not null
